title: extract_message_id should return Option<String> not empty String sentinel
description: queue.rs extract_message_id returns String::new() when no Message-Id header is found (line 61). Using an empty string as a sentinel value for 'not present' is stringly-typed: callers cannot distinguish 'header present with empty value' from 'header absent'. The idiomatic type is Option<String>. Callers in drain_once use it only in log format strings, so unwrap_or_default() or unwrap_or_else(|| "(none)".to_owned()) at each call site is low friction and makes absence explicit.
